name: repo-integrity
description: Repo-level contract checks the doctor runs on every pass: safeguards and verb tiers must match a gate the code enforces, every credential must run as the operator, and every derived table (README, SYSTEMS.md, RISK.md) must match the manifests
surface: doctor-run contract checks: `safeguards[]` and `verbs[]` gate claims verified against code, `auth.principal` honesty (service exceptions and ungated writes named on every run), README / SYSTEMS.md / RISK.md freshness against the manifests, every lockfile directory covered by dependabot.yml or excluded with a reason, no registry credential literal in a tracked file, every skill naming only paths and verbs that exist
safeguards: Read-only by construction: all checks read manifests, source files, and config, print one JSON verdict, and mutate nothing (SENSIBILITIES #1)

risk.worst_case: a false pass that lets a manifest over-claim slip through review

checks.label: safeguards[] gate claims are enforced in code
every credential is the operator's own; every write verb names its real gate
README belt table matches the manifests
SYSTEMS.md, docs/RISK.md and docs/CREDENTIALS.md match the manifests
every lockfile directory is covered by dependabot.yml (or excluded with a reason)
no package-registry credential literal in a tracked file
every skill has a manifest and names only paths and verbs that exist

smoke_test.command: node checks/safeguards-honesty.mjs && node checks/principal-honesty.mjs && node checks/readme-index.mjs && node checks/derived-freshness.mjs && node checks/dependabot-coverage.mjs && node checks/no-credential-literals.mjs && node checks/skills-rot.mjs
